writeup.title: fix(stock): prevent race conditions and release holds on payment failure immediately
writeup.summary: This branch fixes a stock race condition by replacing separate read-and-write checks with a single conditional UPDATE statement. It also ensures that failed or gateway-timed-out payments release their reserved stock holds immediately rather than waiting for TTL expiration.
changes: Replaced read-then-write stock reservation checks with a single atomic conditional UPDATE (`try_reserve`).
Released stock holds immediately upon payment failure or gateway errors via `release_order_holds`.
Updated tests to verify immediate stock release on failed payments and gateway errors.

functions.what_it_does: Marks the order as failed, immediately releases its stock holds, saves the payment attempt, and updates metrics.
Attempts to reserve stock in a single conditional database update, returning True if successful.
Reserves stock for each order line using try_reserve, raising OutOfStock if reservation fails.
Releases all active reservation entries for an order unless the reservation leak fault is enabled.

writeup.release_note: Fixed checkout stock race conditions and made failed/timed-out payments release stock holds immediately.
